tool.name: AlphaFold Database
tool.description: Get pre-computed protein structures (200M+ available, no GPU needed)
tool.help:
**AlphaFold Protein Structure Database**
Instantly retrieve pre-computed AlphaFold structures for 200M+ proteins.
**No GPU or API key required!**
**Example UniProt IDs:** - P00533: EGFR (Epidermal growth factor receptor) - P04637: TP53 (Tumor protein p53) - P38398: BRCA1
**Output:** - 3D structure file (PDB or mmCIF format) - Metadata including confidence scores
**Citation:** Jumper et al. (2021). Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold. Nature.
